data.long_meaning: The Old English name Allred is derived from the Old English elements æl (all) and rīd (ruler). This name was likely given to a ruler or protector in Anglo-Saxon culture. However, some sources suggest that Allred may have been a nickname for someone with red hair or a red face. The name Allred carries the meaning “Ruler of the elves” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Allred usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the elves and live with faith, good character and purpose.
